description: Complete or skip the current plan step. Requires evidence (for complete) or reason (for skip). Automatically promotes the next pending step to active and updates next_move. Enforces continuity — you cannot skip without explaining why.

evidence.description: Required for complete — what proved this step is done

reason.description: Required for skip — why this step is being skipped

step_id.description: Step ID to complete or skip (e.g. 'step-001')

name: plan_advance
